title: The Wolfstone Hillfort
objective: Get past the Reaver's dire wolf into the old hillfort, take what you can from it, and leave by the drovers' camp.

rooms.name: Drovers' Camp
rooms.description: A cold camp below the hillfort's ditch. A drover sits by a cart, and a sheep track winds up the hill behind it.

features.name: Drover's Cart
features.description: A two-wheeled cart loaded with sacks.
features.discovery: Wedged under the sacks are a stoppered vial of red liquid and an iron crowbar.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

items.name: Crowbar
items.description: An iron crowbar, flattened at one end.

creatures.name: Wenna the Drover
creatures.description: A weathered drover with a crook across her knees and a pack of goods to sell.

topics.name: the hillfort
topics.reply: "The Reaver took the keep. His wolf runs the ditch, and there's a bear in the old undercroft."

topics.name: the sheep track
topics.reply: "Up past the thorn and you'll find the old watchtower. Mind the stair."

rooms.name: Outer Ditch
rooms.description: A deep ditch below the rampart, littered with gnawed bones. A rusted portcullis blocks the gate passage.

features.name: Wolf's Lair
features.description: A hollow under the rampart, matted with fur.
features.discovery: Among the bones lie a drover's purse and a silver sheep bell.

items.name: Silver Sheep Bell
items.description: A silver bell engraved with a running wolf.

rooms.name: Old Watchtower
rooms.description: A roofless tower on the hill's shoulder, looking down into the fort.

features.name: Lookout's Niche
features.description: A niche in the wall, out of the wind.
features.discovery: A coil of knotted rope and a stoppered vial of red liquid lie in the niche.

items.name: Knotted Rope
items.description: Fifty feet of hempen rope, knotted every foot.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

rooms.name: Gatehouse
rooms.description: A broken gatehouse inside the rampart. A rope bridge sags across a ravine towards the keep, and steps lead down into the undercroft.

features.name: Rope Bridge
features.description: Frayed ropes and rotten planks over a deep ravine.

failure-by-5.text: Planks snap under you. You catch a rope and swing into the ravine wall, and the bridge falls away behind you.

failure.text: The bridge bucks and sways, and you scramble back to the gatehouse.

success.text: You cross the bridge plank by plank to the keep's door.

features.name: Guard Locker
features.description: A dented iron locker against the wall.
features.discovery: At the back of the locker is a red-veined bloodstone.

items.name: Bloodstone
items.description: A dark green stone flecked with red.

rooms.name: Undercroft
rooms.description: A collapsed undercroft that stinks of bear. A stair at the far end climbs towards the keep.

features.name: Heap of Bones
features.description: Bones and rags dragged into a corner.
features.discovery: Under the rags are a stoppered vial of red liquid and a milky moonstone.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

rooms.name: Keep Hall
rooms.description: The hall of the old keep, hung with stolen banners. The Reaver's strongbox sits under the high table.

features.name: Reaver's Strongbox
features.description: An iron-bound strongbox under the high table.
features.discovery: Inside are a silver-gilt drinking horn and a bag of gold.

items.name: Silver-gilt Drinking Horn
items.description: A drinking horn bound in silver-gilt and carved with hunting scenes.

items.name: Reaver's Coins
items.description: A heavy pouch of gold pieces.

passages.description: The track down into the ditch.
The sheep track up the hill.

door.name: Rusted Portcullis
door.description: A rusted portcullis, jammed a foot off the ground.

passages.description: The steps down into the undercroft.
The rope bridge over the ravine.

opponents.name: Reaver's Wolf
opponents.description: A dire wolf the size of a pony, a spiked collar round its neck.

opponents.name: The Wolfstone Reaver
opponents.description: A scarred bandit captain in a wolfskin cloak, a scimitar in each hand.

endings.title: Out with the plunder
endings.text: You leave the hillfort by the drovers' camp with the Reaver's plunder.

endings.title: Out empty-handed
endings.text: You leave the hillfort by the drovers' camp with nothing to show for it.

endings.title: Fallen at Wolfstone
endings.text: You fall in the hillfort's shadow. Your adventuring ends here.
